'''''The Seeker''''' was a civilian [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI bulk transport]] that was present at [[Calast]], a [[Golan Space Colony 2]] space station during the [[Rescue at Bundil II|Skirmish at Calast station]]. The ship contained livestock.
